About me

I am an Assistant Researcher at the Laboratory of Multimedia Computing (LMC), School of Computer Science, Hefei University of Technology (HFUT). I received my Ph.D. from HFUT in December 2025, advised by Prof. Richang Hong. My research focuses on the security and privacy of generative AI, particularly AI-generated image detection, generative model unlearning, and training-data protection.

Laboratory of Multimedia Computing（LMC） · Hefei University of Technology

02 /

Research interests

[ 01 ]

AI-generated image forensics

Studying reconstruction geometry and edit-induced error shifts to detect synthetic images without detector training.

[ 02 ]

Generative model unlearning

Controlling unwanted generalization in diffusion and score-based models through targeted score adjustment.

[ 03 ]

Data protection & learnability

Examining the limits of unlearnable examples and the recovery of learnability through diffusion-based purification.

Earlier research: algebraic coding theory and entanglement-assisted quantum error-correcting codes (EAQECCs), including cyclic, negacyclic, and constacyclic constructions.
